claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the shampoo for leaving hair soft, manageable, and healthy-feeling.
Many reviewers say it soothes dry or itchy scalps and improves scalp health.
Several reviewers mention difficulty finding the product in local stores and are glad to find it online.
Reviewers commonly praise the pleasant scent.
A few reviewers note it did not deliver expected benefits like added body or nourishment for their hair type.
